parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name. This parameter is required and must be specified when you call this operation.

parameters.name: FirewallType
parameters.description: The type of the cloud firewall.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP address version. Valid values: **4** (IPv4) and **6** (IPv6).

> This parameter is unconditionally required and has no dependency on RegionNo. If this parameter is not specified, the error MissingParameter.IpVersion is returned (-200157). If the value is invalid, the error ErrorParameterIpVersion is returned (-200135).

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the error MissingParameter.RegionNo is returned (-200155, The required parameter 'RegionNo' is not provided.).
